name: QUESTION_FORMAT_TYPE
description: The type of question represented, for example, multiple-choice, yes/no, and open-ended.

description: This minor entity describes the type of quota that an employee has such as number of customers, number of accounts, number of transactions, and number of sales of a product.

name: REAL_ESTATE_TYPE

name: REAL_ESTATE_ZONE_TYPE

name: RECEIVER_USER_SETTING
description: Captures information regarding the user setup values for the device.

name: TRAVEL_PLAN_DESTINATION
description: This is the destination country or other geographical area during the trip.

name: TV_SYSTEM_TYPE

description: This entity classifies the type of visit regarding the channel visited.  Examples: - Web visit - Branch visit - Call center call

name: WORKSTATION_TERMINAL
description: This entity tracks all the workstation terminals that are related to potential sales or service channels such as the terminals at a branch or call center.

name: WORK_PROCESS
description: This entity describes a standard workflow process such as approving or processing an insurance claim or a loan. The process is made up of steps. The process may result in the creation of projects where time and resources are assigned to tasks and deliverables are produced.

description: This is the role that one work process has with another work process such as "follows" or "replaces".

name: WORK_PROCESS_STATUS_TYPE
description: This describes the status of this work process such as in development, in production, or suspended.

description: This entity captures the actual steps that are involved in this process.  If you need to capture a history of estimated completion dates then you can create a separate dependent "date" entity to track the history.

name: WORK_PROCESS_STEP_ACTUAL_SUBTYPE
description: This is a code used as a subtype discriminator to contain information about specific types of workflow processes such as the employment process.

name: WORK_PROCESS_STEP_STANDARD
description: This entity captures the standard steps that are involved in this process.
